justification: DECEPTIVE. The interface presents two mutually inconsistent payment claims in the same offer container: "No charges during your trial period" and "Payment of $49.00 due today at signup." This satisfies Conflicting Information conditions 1 and 3 as an observed, proximally co-located contradiction in state s0, corroborated by DOM, semantic text, and vision. O1 finds no timer, O2 no inventory change, O3 no observed opt-out state, O5 no consent control, and O6 finds no close/cancel control; these operators neither negate nor independently establish the contradiction. E1 does not resolve the factual conflict, E2 prevents treating the visible payment disclosure as hidden cost, E3, E4, E5, and E6 are not applicable to the observed contradiction. Confidence is below 0.95 because only one rendered state is available and the underlying billing semantics are not observable.
vision_observation: The visual sheet shows a prominent purple "Start your FREE trial" message and full-width "Start free trial" button. In smaller but visible text it states "No charges during your trial period" and, below a divider, "Payment of $49.00 due today at signup." The same sheet also shows "Trial offer · $49.00/mo after"; no cancel, decline, or alternative action is visible.
dom_observation: The complete DOM trace contains one rendered state labeled s0. Within one bordered AcmeStream Pro offer container, the visible text nodes are "Trial offer · $49.00/mo after", "Start your FREE trial", "No charges during your trial period.", "Payment of $49.00 due today at signup.", and the button "Start free trial". There is no timer, inventory counter, checkbox, close button, cancel link, or second state transition represented in the DOM.

It provides no trial duration, deadline, cancellation language, consent control, inventory claim, or activity claim. The immediate-payment statement and no-charges-during-trial statement are incompatible when signup initiates the trial.
